remarks: Location Location Location!! 1 of 5 Properties that back up to Acres and Acres of Wooded City Property that offers complete privacy. Within walking distance of the 200+ acres Cranbury park that offers walking trails, playgrounds and so much more. 2 of the 3 schools in this school district are or will be Brand New (Cranbury School Elementary, one year old, Norwalk High School will be new next year). This location is 1 acre surrounded with many mature trees that take decades to grow, offering privacy and a great tree canopy helping with the energy efficiency in the Summer. You're not sacrificing City conveniences at this Country Estate though. You're mere minutes to Rt. 7 and all the shopping it has to offer, 95 or 15 are also within minutes. There is a large screened in porch that leads out to an oversized slate patio that surrounds the inground pool offering your own Summer vacation destination. The home itself offers 4 bedrooms, 3 of which are good size and the Master which is oversized with a walk in closet and bathroom ready for your personal touches to bring it to today's standards. The Main floor offers 3 walls of picture Windows that frame nature all year long, whether sitting in your eat in kitchen, sharing a meal at your dining room table, or holding a conversation in your formal living room.. The first floor offers a 500+ square ft Family room, that really can function in multiple capacities with custom built in bookshelves.
